$comment: Single source of truth for the Insights views. The plugin reads id, label and tooltip (nav strip order, labels, hover text). The documentation generator (scripts/docs.mjs) reads every field to build the README and the GitHub Pages site. Add or change a view here, then run `npm run docs`.

views.label: Co-authorship
views.tooltip: Co-authorship network: each dot is an author, a line links authors who share a paper. Bigger dots wrote more.
views.summary: Authors as nodes, with a line between two authors who share a paper. Bigger nodes wrote more of your items.
details: Built from the creators field of every regular item, so it is correct for the whole library.
Large libraries keep the 400 authors with the most items, so the view stays smooth.
Drag a node to pin it, pan the canvas, and zoom with the mouse wheel.
Re-layout, Fit and Release pins buttons in the header.

views.label: Author / paper
views.tooltip: Your papers and their authors, linked by who wrote what. Best on a Curated set; the whole library is capped to the most co-authored papers.
views.summary: A two-sided network of your papers and their authors: who wrote what.
details: Click a paper node to open that paper in your library.
Works best on a curated set. On the whole library it keeps the most co-authored papers, up to 400 nodes.
Same drag, pan, zoom and pin controls as the co-authorship network.

views.label: Publications / year
views.tooltip: How many items you have per publication year. Click a bar to find that year's items in your library.
views.summary: A histogram of your items per publication year, with a separate bar for undated items.
details: Hover a bar for the exact count.
Click a bar to search your library for that year's items.

views.label: Top sources
views.tooltip: The journals and conferences that appear most in this set. Click one to find its items in your library.
views.summary: A ranked bar chart of the journals and conferences that appear most often.
details: Choose how many sources to show with the Top-N box in the header.
Click a bar to search your library for that source.

views.label: Top authors
views.tooltip: Authors ranked by how many of your items they wrote. Click one to find their items in your library.
views.summary: A ranked bar chart of authors by the number of your items they wrote.
details: Choose how many authors to show with the Top-N box in the header.
Click a bar to search your library for that author.

views.label: Composition
views.tooltip: A breakdown of your items by type and by collection. Click a slice to see those items.
views.summary: Two donut charts: your items by item type and by collection.
details: Hover a slice for its count and percentage.
Click an item-type slice to select those items, or a collection slice to open that collection.

views.label: Set
views.tooltip: Manage the curated set, the specific papers Insights focuses on. Add papers by right-clicking them in the library.
views.summary: The list of papers in your curated set, the specific papers Insights focuses on.
details: Each row shows the title, first author and year. Double-click a row to show the paper in your library.
Remove one paper with its trash button, or empty the set with Clear all.
Add current selection adds the items selected in the library.
